summary: The patch addresses the issue of callable storage on FileField not being deconstructed correctly. It introduces a new attribute `_storage_callable` to track the callable and ensures it is included in the deconstructed form.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new attribute `_storage_callable` which is not mentioned in the documentation or comments.
The patch slightly increases the complexity of the `deconstruct` method by adding a check for `_storage_callable`, which might affect readability for future maintainers.
